title: Foreign Exchange Rates
intro: حدد **العملة الوظيفية** (عملة البيئة الاقتصادية الرئيسية) أولاً.
المعاملة تُسجل بـ **السعر الفوري** يوم المعاملة. في نهاية السنة: البنود **النقدية** بسعر الإقفال، وغير النقدية بالتكلفة تبقى بالسعر التاريخي.
فروق تحويل البنود النقدية ← أرباح وخسائر. فروق ترجمة العمليات الأجنبية ← الدخل الشامل الآخر.

tf.s: Non-monetary items carried at historical cost are translated at the historical rate.
The presentation currency must be the same as the functional currency.
tf.why: Any presentation currency may be chosen.

tf.s: Exchange differences on translating a foreign operation are recognised in OCI.
tf.why: They are reclassified to P&L on disposal.

tf.s: An average rate may be used for income and expenses if rates do not fluctuate significantly.
Inventory bought in foreign currency is retranslated at the closing rate each year-end.
tf.why: Inventory is non-monetary; it stays at the historical rate.

tf.s: Monetary items include cash and amounts receivable or payable in a fixed number of currency units.

fill.s: Foreign currency transactions are first recorded at the ___ rate.
Monetary items are retranslated at the ___ rate.
Translation differences of a foreign operation go to ___.
Functional currency is the currency of the primary economic ___.
